## Course Texts

- Dayal, Geeta. *Another Green World*. New York: Continuum, 2009.
- Gross, Benedikt, Hartmut Bohnacker, and Julia Laub. [*Generative Design: Visualize, Program, and Create with P5.js*](http://www.generative-gestaltung.de/2/). Princeton, NJ: Princeton Architectural Press, 2018.
- Philip, Terry, editor. *The Penguin Book of Oulipo*. London: Penguin Classics, 2020.

## Films & Documentaries

- Miller, Allan, and Paul Smaczny, directors. *John Cage: Journeys in Sound*. 2012.
- Hustwit, Gary, director. [*Eno*](https://www.hustwit.com/eno). 2024.

## Articles & Essays

- Eno, Brian. "Generating and Organizing Variety in the Arts." *Studio International*, 1976.
- Reich, Steve. "Music as a Gradual Process." 1968.
- Noll, A. Michael. "Human or Machine? A Subjective Comparison of Piet Mondrian's 'Composition With Lines' (1917) and a Computer-Generated Picture." *The Psychological Record*, vol. 16, no. 1, 1966, pp. 1-10.
- Manovich, Lev. "Who is 'An Artist' in the 'AI Era'?" 2023.
- Parkin, Simon. "[A Journey to the End of the World (of Minecraft)](https://www.newyorker.com/tech/annals-of-technology/a-journey-to-the-end-of-the-world-of-minecraft)." *The New Yorker*, 23 Jan. 2014.

## Music & Audio

- Eno, Brian. *Music for Airports*. Album liner notes. 1978.
- Riley, Terry. *In C*. Musical composition. 1964.
- Eno, Brian. [*77 Million Paintings*](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/77_Million_Paintings). Generative art installation. 2006.

## Online Articles

- Goodchild, Amy. "[Early Computer Art in the '50s and '60s](https://www.amygoodchild.com/blog/computer-art-50s-and-60s)." 2020.
- Reverb Machine. "[How Brian Eno Created 'Discreet Music'](https://reverbmachine.com/blog/deconstructing-brian-enos-discreet-music/)." 2019.
- "[Mandelbulb](https://www.mandelbulb.com/)." 2024.
- Queneau, Raymond. "[A Hundred Thousand Billion Poems - Interactive Edition](https://www.bevrowe.info/Internet/Queneau/Queneau.html)." Original work 1961, interactive edition by Bev Rowe.
- Clouth, Rob. "[The Harry Potter Book Generator](https://robclouth.com/#projects/the-harry-potter-book-generator)." 2020.
- Marian42. "[Wave Function Collapse](https://marian42.itch.io/wfc)." 2019.

## Media

- "[Early 3D Computer Graphics from Bell Labs](https://youtu.be/M4nql28E_AE)." YouTube, 1963.
- bib993. "[3D Fractal Worlds](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xj_4jvSDVME&list=PL1ywvug1r6ThGOrb9vQNfqYsI5XNyV3B3)." YouTube playlist, 2020.
- "[7 Hours in 77 Million Paintings](https://vimeo.com/groups/chillounge/videos/751767)." Vimeo, 2014. 420 mins. > 35 mins. timelapse.
- h2ee. "[T1 Shader](https://shaderpark.com/sculpture/-OZ3EHXk8r1JyhqgVTCy)." ShaderPark, 2024.

## Interviews

- [Josef Pelz](https://www.generativehut.com/post/interview-with-josef-pelz)
- [Étienne Jacob](https://www.generativehut.com/post/interview-with-etienne-jacob)
- [Shohei Fujimoto](https://www.generativehut.com/post/interview-with-shohei-fujimoto)
- [Giulia Cosco](https://www.generativehut.com/post/interview-with-giulia-cosco)
- [Pierre Paslier](https://www.generativehut.com/post/interview-with-pierre-paslier)
